subject.title: Gateway should expose HTTP REST endpoints for common queries

question: Should OpenClaw expose read-only session list/detail data through the existing default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin, through new dedicated REST GET endpoints, or keep that data on WebSocket/CLI surfaces for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing session data over HTTP changes a security-sensitive operator API boundary and creates a public integration contract.

options.title: Extend Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add read-only session query methods to the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin with docs and route/auth/allowlist tests.

options.title: Add Dedicated REST Endpoints
options.body: Create authenticated GET routes for sessions and agents if maintainers want REST semantics instead of JSON-RPC over HTTP.

options.title: Defer HTTP Session Exposure
options.body: Keep session list/detail access on WebSocket and CLI until maintainers are ready to own a broader HTTP control-plane contract.

recommendation.title: Extend Admin HTTP RPC
recommendation.body: Add read-only session query methods to the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin with docs and route/auth/allowlist tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the strongest current history signal for the privileged admin HTTP RPC and Gateway security-boundary work.
